name: @life-optimizer/db
description: PostgreSQL persistence for Life Optimizer (Prisma schema, migrations, repositories)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/feature-flags build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/core build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/financial build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/patron build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/util build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/ai build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/email build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/sms build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/notifications build && pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/core build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/financial build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/patron build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/util build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/ai build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/email build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/sms build && pnpm --filter @life-optimizer/notifications build && pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json
